    return res.forecast(horizon=horizon).variance.values[-1]

lifecycle_stages.name: Market Data & Macro Ingestion
lifecycle_stages.narrative: Real-time tick data streams from the MT5 broker gateway concurrently with macroeconomic releases from FRED. Ticks are checked for price gap anomalies, while alternative news sentiment is vectorized into real-time market tensors.

lifecycle_stages.name: Macro & Microstructure Regime Filter
lifecycle_stages.narrative: The Bayesian Online Changepoint Detector and Hidden Markov Models analyze current volatility clustering. If high-impact news releases or flash spreads are detected, the News Trading Gate throttles new order entry.

lifecycle_stages.name: Alpha Mining & Factor Discovery
lifecycle_stages.narrative: Active alpha signals are computed using genetic programming factors. Signals undergo Gram-Schmidt orthogonalization to strip out multi-collinearity, producing a pure, non-redundant ensemble alpha score.

lifecycle_stages.name: Multi-Agent LLM Deliberation
lifecycle_stages.narrative: The Autonomous Multi-Agent Hive initiates structured deliberation. The GRPO Proposer drafts trade candidates with thesis and confidence; the Market Critic scrutinizes counter-evidence; and the LLM Veto Operator filters hallucinations.

lifecycle_stages.name: Quantitative Risk & Overfit Gating
lifecycle_stages.narrative: The candidate trade passes through the statistical Overfit Gate where Deflated Sharpe Ratio confirms validity. The Risk Manager calculates fractional Kelly lot sizing while verifying correlation and margin ceilings.

lifecycle_stages.name: Dual-Velocity MT5 Order Routing
lifecycle_stages.narrative: Authorized trade lots are sliced by the Optimal Execution Scheduler using adaptive TWAP/VWAP trajectories to minimize slippage. Direct memory-mapped socket requests execute orders with broker-side hard stops attached.

lifecycle_stages.name: Memory Persistence & EWC Meta-Loop
lifecycle_stages.narrative: Execution fills, slippage, and timestamps are committed to ACID SQLite journal. The EWC engine updates the diagonal Fisher Information Matrix to retain learned patterns across regime shifts without catastrophic forgetting.
